seoTitle: Cheapest AI phone answering for pizza shops, no monthly fee
description: What a pizza shop pays for AI phone answering with no monthly fee: flat $0.90 per order vs 2%, about 6% and $1.50 per order at $20 to $60 tickets.
lead: Pizza shops live on the phone, and most of the calls are quick pickup orders. If you want AI to answer them without a monthly bill, the cheapest option depends on one number: your average phone ticket.
question: What is the cheapest AI receptionist for a pizza shop with no monthly fee?
answer: No-monthly-fee AI phone services for pizza shops charge per order, either a flat fee (commonly $0.90 to $1.50) or a percentage of the order (commonly 2% to about 6%). ROAL charges a flat $0.90 per completed order with no monthly fee, setup fee or contract. On a $30 pizza order that is $0.90, versus $0.60 at 2%, about $1.80 at 6% and $1.50 at a $1.50 flat fee. A 2% fee is the cheapest when your average ticket is under $45; above that, a flat $0.90 costs less.

verdict: For a pizza shop with no appetite for a monthly bill, per-order pricing is the low-risk choice. A 2% fee is the cheapest when most phone orders are small. A flat $0.90 costs less than a $1.50 flat fee or a 6% fee on any order, and less than 2% once your average ticket passes $45. Run your own numbers with last month's phone orders before you choose.

sections.h2: Work out what your shop would pay
sections.body:
Take two numbers from last month: phone orders and your average phone ticket. Then:

1. **Flat $0.90:** orders × $0.90. 200 orders = **$180**.
2. **Percentage:** orders × average ticket × rate. 200 × $30 × 2% = **$120**; at 6% = **$360**.
3. **Flat $1.50:** 200 × $1.50 = **$300**.

Pizza tickets swing a lot between a lunch slice and a Friday family order, so use your real average. The [AI phone host cost calculator](/tools/phone-host-cost-calculator) does the math, and the [missed call calculator](/tools/missed-call-calculator) shows what unanswered calls are worth before you pay anyone.

- **Half-and-half and toppings.** Call a test host and order a half-and-half pie with a crust change. If it gets that wrong, the price doesn't matter.
- **Where the ticket lands.** ROAL sends each order to a kitchen screen with the items, name and phone, ready to make.
- **Delivery areas and hours.** The host should know your hours, specials and delivery rules, and hand off to staff for anything it can't answer.
- **Your number stays yours.** You forward your existing number, all the time or only when the line is busy. See the [call forwarding codes](/tools/call-forwarding-codes).

More on pizza calls in [AI phone answering for pizza shops](/for/pizza) and the full per-order comparison in [flat fee vs percentage](/compare/per-order-pricing).

faq.a: 2% is cheaper when your average phone ticket is under $45, and $0.90 is cheaper above that. At exactly $45 they cost the same.

faq.q: Does ROAL charge for calls that aren't orders?
